ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 85-90% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage across the central ventral field with 10-15% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at the trailing edges and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous high-intensity white field. Continuous low-intensity black border along the trailing edge. Distinct cluster of vertical black linear segments on the upper-left lobe. Symmetrical black pigmentation at distal tips. Subtle mid-range intensity (tan/yellow) wash localized in the lower central region near the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary. Inner lobe segments exhibit low-amplitude, high-frequency variations. Distal tips exhibit high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Gently convex curve along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-intensity (white) roughly circular pixels concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of approximately 10-12 vertical, parallel, low-intensity (black) linear pixel disruptions on the upper-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical rake-mark pattern on the left lobe; single small, isolated low-intensity circular spot on the upper-right lobe near the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Single distinct circular black spot located on the far right lobe, approximately 10% from the lateral tip.
